open_points.subject: load_configuration validation note
open_points.text: items within one check taken in the order store_path, backup_dir, backup_key, owner_credential, owner_listen, token_presupro, token_client_portal, token_cabinet, token_cabinet_kernel, service_listen
open_points.rule: Inline-данные: таблицы соответствий, allow-lists, пороги, TTL, пути, рейтинги, размеры, словари alias'ов.
open_points.question: The ordered field set must become an imported policy constant, and the note must name that imported constant.

open_points.subject: load_configuration validation note
open_points.text: the four tokens and service_listen all set or all unset, a partial set failing on its first unset item; store_path, backup_dir, backup_key, owner_credential and owner_listen each set
open_points.rule: Inline-данные: таблицы соответствий, allow-lists, пороги, TTL, пути, рейтинги, размеры, словари alias'ов.
open_points.question: The two closed field sets must be supplied through imported constants, while the note retains only the validation behavior using those constants.

open_points.subject: load_configuration validation note
open_points.text: each secret at least the imported SECRET_MIN_BYTES constant in UTF-8 bytes, a secret whose text cannot be written as UTF-8 failing that check for its item
open_points.rule: Таблица выше — исчерпывающий список путей значения, и у каждого из них своя форма: перечисление называется адресом, константа поставщика — `the imported X constant`, настройка — полем объекта настроек.
open_points.question: The encoding choice must be provided by an imported constant and named as that imported constant instead of being embedded as UTF-8 in the note.

open_points.subject: load_configuration schema note
open_points.text: MUST accept an address only as host:port with no white space and no sign: the host either a dotted-decimal IPv4 address with no leading zero in any part but a lone zero, or a bracketed IPv6 address in any text form of the IPv6 addressing architecture's text representation, compressed or not and in either letter case, with no zone identifier and not IPv4-mapped; the port ASCII decimal digits without a leading zero
open_points.rule: Нота остаётся требованием к поведению: выражения, вызовы методов, точечная навигация и строковый микро-синтаксис в ней запрещены.
open_points.question: The address grammar must become a declared contract or imported policy symbol; the note must state the validation behavior without embedding the host:port string micro-syntax.

open_points.subject: load_configuration test-evidence note
open_points.text: a value one UTF-8 byte shorter than the imported SECRET_MIN_BYTES constant answers a StartDiagnostic naming its item and one of exactly that many bytes passes, a value of two-byte characters counted by its bytes and not its characters
open_points.rule: Таблица выше — исчерпывающий список путей значения, и у каждого из них своя форма: перечисление называется адресом, константа поставщика — `the imported X constant`, настройка — полем объекта настроек.
open_points.question: The test evidence must refer to the imported encoding-policy constant rather than embedding UTF-8 as the encoding value.
